## Deployed Application

**Live URL:** <http://JiraClone-ALB-1154595828.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com>

> Clicking the link opens the live Mini-Jira web application directly. The application is fronted by an Application Load Balancer (`JiraClone-ALB`) in `us-east-1`, with EC2 instances running across two Availability Zones behind an Auto Scaling Group.

---

## 1. High-Availability Architecture Diagram

The diagram below shows the full Mini-Jira deployment. The app is deployed across **two Availability Zones** (`us-east-1a` and `us-east-1b`) inside a single VPC. CloudFront sits in front of an Application Load Balancer; EC2 instances run in private subnets behind a NAT gateway; all data is persisted in DynamoDB and S3.

## 2. Request & Data Flow (numbered, matches diagram)

| # | Flow | Description |
|---|------|-------------|
| 1 | **User → CloudFront** | Browser hits the CloudFront distribution URL (HTTPS, edge-cached static assets). |
| 2 | **CloudFront → ALB** | Dynamic API requests are forwarded to the Application Load Balancer in the public subnets. |
| 3 | **ALB → EC2 (ASG)** | The ALB health-checks and round-robins traffic to Node.js instances in private subnets across AZ-A and AZ-B. |
| 4 | **EC2 → Cognito** | Every request carries a JWT issued by the Cognito User Pool. The backend validates the token and extracts `role` and `teamId` from custom attributes. |
| 5 | **EC2 → DynamoDB** | All CRUD goes to DynamoDB. Reads for employees use the `teamId-index` GSI; the team check is enforced on every handler. |
| 6 | **EC2 → S3 (originals)** | Image uploads use pre-signed PUT URLs directly from the browser to the originals bucket. |
| 7 | **S3 (originals) → Lambda (Resize)** | An S3 `ObjectCreated:*` event triggers the resize Lambda. |
| 8 | **Lambda (Resize) → S3 (resized)** | Thumbnails are written to the resized bucket; the task record is updated with both URLs. |
| 9 | **EC2 → SNS** | When a manager assigns a task, the backend publishes a `TaskAssigned` event to the SNS topic. |
| 10 | **SNS → Email** | The assignee gets an email notification (SES via SNS email subscription). |
| 11 | **SNS → SQS** | The same event is fanned out to an SQS queue for durable processing. |
| 12 | **SQS → Lambda (Worker)** | The worker Lambda drains the queue, writes an activity-log entry to DynamoDB, and publishes the `TasksAssignedPerTeam` custom CloudWatch metric. |
| 13 | **EventBridge → Lambda (Digest)** | A scheduled rule (`cron(0 9 * * ? *)`) fires daily at 09:00. The digest Lambda scans tasks due today and sends per-assignee digest emails through SNS. |
| 14 | **All compute → CloudWatch** | Logs, EC2 CPU, Lambda invocations, custom metrics, and alarms are aggregated into the Mini-Jira dashboard. |

## 3. AWS Services — Role & Justification

| Service | Icon | Role in Mini-Jira |
|---|---|---|
| **Amazon CloudFront** | ![cf](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Networking-Content-Delivery/CloudFront.svg) | Global CDN in front of the ALB. Caches static React assets and lowers TTFB for the demo. |
| **Application Load Balancer** | ![alb](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Networking-Content-Delivery/Elastic-Load-Balancing.svg) | Layer-7 load balancer distributing HTTP traffic across EC2 instances in two AZs. Performs health checks on `/api/health`. |
| **Amazon EC2 (Auto Scaling Group)** | ![ec2](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Compute/EC2.svg) | Hosts the Node.js / Express backend. ASG min=2, max=4, desired=2 — one instance per AZ to satisfy HA. |
| **Amazon VPC** | ![vpc](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Networking-Content-Delivery/Virtual-Private-Cloud.svg) | Network isolation. Two public subnets (ALB + NAT) and two private subnets (EC2) spread across `us-east-1a` and `us-east-1b`. |
| **NAT Gateway** | ![nat](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Networking-Content-Delivery/Virtual-Private-Cloud.svg) | Lets private EC2 instances reach AWS service endpoints (SNS, Cognito, etc.) without public IPs. |
| **Amazon DynamoDB** | ![ddb](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Database/DynamoDB.svg) | Primary data store. Tables: `Users`, `Teams`, `Projects`, `Tasks`, `Comments`, `AuditLog`. GSIs on `teamId-index` and `assigneeId-index`. |
| **Amazon S3 (originals)** | ![s3](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Storage/Simple-Storage-Service.svg) | Stores original task image uploads. Versioning enabled so updates retain previous versions. |
| **Amazon S3 (resized)** | ![s3](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Storage/Simple-Storage-Service.svg) | Stores 256×256 thumbnails produced by the resize Lambda. Public-read via CloudFront. |
| **AWS Lambda — Image Resize** | ![lambda](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Compute/Lambda.svg) | Triggered by S3 `PUT` on the originals bucket. Uses `sharp` to produce a thumbnail and writes it to the resized bucket. |
| **AWS Lambda — Assignment Worker** | ![lambda](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Compute/Lambda.svg) | SQS-triggered. Writes audit log entries and emits the `TasksAssignedPerTeam` CloudWatch custom metric. |
| **AWS Lambda — Daily Digest** | ![lambda](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Compute/Lambda.svg) | EventBridge-triggered at 09:00 daily. Scans tasks due today and sends digest emails through SNS. |
| **Amazon SNS** | ![sns](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/App-Integration/Simple-Notification-Service.svg) | Fan-out topic for task-assignment events. Subscribers: email + SQS. Also used by the daily digest. |
| **Amazon SQS** | ![sqs](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/App-Integration/Simple-Queue-Service.svg) | Buffers assignment events for the worker Lambda. Decouples the API from background work; provides retries via a DLQ. |
| **Amazon EventBridge** | ![eb](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/App-Integration/EventBridge.svg) | Scheduled rule (`cron(0 9 * * ? *)`) that triggers the daily-digest Lambda. |
| **Amazon Cognito** | ![cog](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Security-Identity-Compliance/Cognito.svg) | User pool with custom attributes `custom:role` (Manager / Employee / Admin) and `custom:teamId`. Tokens validated by the backend on every API call. |
| **Amazon CloudWatch** | ![cw](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Management-Governance/CloudWatch.svg) | Centralised logs, custom metrics, dashboard (4 widgets), and an alarm on overdue tasks that notifies an SNS topic. |
| **AWS IAM** | ![iam](https://icon.icepanel.io/AWS/svg/Security-Identity-Compliance/Identity-and-Access-Management.svg) | Least-privilege roles: one for EC2 (DynamoDB + S3 + SNS), one per Lambda, one for the Cognito-authenticated app identity. See the full **IAM Audit Report** in Section 8. |

## 4. High-Availability Justification

| HA Requirement | How it is met |
|---|---|
| **Multi-AZ compute** | Auto Scaling Group launches EC2 instances in `us-east-1a` and `us-east-1b`. If an AZ fails, ALB reroutes to the surviving AZ. |
| **Multi-AZ load balancing** | The ALB itself has nodes in both public subnets — it is regional and HA by design. |
| **Multi-AZ data** | DynamoDB is a regional service; data is automatically replicated across three AZs. |
| **Multi-AZ object storage** | S3 stores objects redundantly across multiple AZs (standard storage class). |
| **Stateless backend** | EC2 instances hold no session state — JWTs from Cognito carry identity. Any instance can serve any request. |
| **Edge resilience** | CloudFront has 600+ PoPs; it absorbs traffic spikes and shields the origin. |
| **Decoupling** | SNS + SQS isolate the API from background processing — a Lambda failure does not break task creation. |

## 5. DynamoDB Schema (summary)

```
Tasks
  PK: taskId (string)
  Attributes: title, description, status, priority, deadline, assigneeId, teamId, projectId, imageUrl, thumbnailUrl, createdAt, updatedAt
  GSI 1: teamId-index       (PK = teamId,     SK = createdAt)   -- employee queries
  GSI 2: assigneeId-index   (PK = assigneeId, SK = deadline)    -- "my tasks" view

Users        PK: userId
Teams        PK: teamId
Projects     PK: projectId
Comments     PK: commentId   GSI: taskId-index
AuditLog     PK: auditId     GSI: taskId-index
```

**Team-isolation rule (enforced in every handler):**

```js
// Pseudocode — runs before every Task read/write
if (user.role !== 'Manager' && task.teamId !== user.teamId) {
  return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden — team isolation' });
}
```

## 6. CloudWatch Dashboard (required widgets)

| Widget | Metric source |
|---|---|
| Tasks created per day | Custom metric `TasksCreated` (namespace `MiniJira`) |
| Tasks closed per day per team | Custom metric `TasksClosed` dimensioned by `teamId` |
| Average time-to-close | Custom metric `TimeToCloseSeconds` (avg statistic) |
| EC2 CPU utilization | `AWS/EC2 CPUUtilization` for the ASG |

**Alarm:** `OverdueTasks > 5` for 1 datapoint → publishes to SNS topic `mini-jira-alerts`.

## 8. IAM Audit Report — JiraClone

**Date:** 2026-05-22
**Audited by:** Member 6 (QA & Monitoring Lead)
**Region:** us-east-1
**Account:** 455587032991

### Summary

This report audits all IAM roles created for the JiraClone project. Each role follows the **least-privilege principle** — permissions are scoped to only the specific actions and resources each service requires.

| Role | Used By | Policy Type |
|---|---|---|
| JiraClone-EC2-Role | EC2 instances in Auto Scaling Group | 1 managed + 1 inline |
| JiraClone-Lambda-ImageResizer-Role | image-resizer Lambda | 1 managed + 1 inline |
| JiraClone-Lambda-Notifier-Role | assignment-notifier Lambda | 1 managed + 1 inline |
| JiraClone-Lambda-Logger-Role | activity-logger Lambda | 1 managed + 1 inline |
| JiraClone-Lambda-Digest-Role | daily-digest Lambda | 1 managed + 1 inline |

---

### JiraClone-EC2-Role

**Used by:** EC2 instances in the JiraClone Auto Scaling Group (`JiraClone-ASG`)
**Purpose:** Allows the Next.js application running on EC2 to interact with all required AWS services at runtime.

**Attached Managed Policies**

| Policy | Justification |
|---|---|
| `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` | Allows EC2 instances to be managed via AWS Systems Manager (SSM). Required for secure remote access without opening SSH ports, and for fetching secrets from SSM Parameter Store at startup. |
| `AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole` | Grants basic CloudWatch Logs write access so application logs from the EC2 instance are captured. |

**Inline Policy: `EC2AppPolicy`**

| Permission | Resource | Justification |
|---|---|---|
| `dynamodb:GetItem`, `PutItem`, `UpdateItem`, `DeleteItem`, `Query`, `Scan` | `arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/JiraClone-*` and all GSIs | Next.js Server Actions read and write all 6 JiraClone DynamoDB tables. Scoped to `JiraClone-*` prefix only — no access to other tables. |
| `cognito-idp:GetUser`, `ListUsers` | `*` | EC2 verifies Cognito JWT tokens and looks up user attributes for authorization. Read-only — cannot create, delete, or modify Cognito users. |
| `s3:PutObject`, `GetObject`, `DeleteObject` | `jiraclone-uploads-*/*`, `jiraclone-thumbnails-*/*` | EC2 generates pre-signed URLs for task image uploads and retrieves thumbnails. Scoped to JiraClone S3 buckets only. |
| `s3:ListBucket`, `ListBucketVersions` | `jiraclone-uploads-*`, `jiraclone-thumbnails-*` | Required to list bucket contents for pre-signed URL generation. Scoped to JiraClone buckets only. |
| `s3:DeleteObjectVersion` | `jiraclone-uploads-*/*` | Allows cleanup of versioned upload objects. Scoped to uploads bucket only — not thumbnails. |
| `sns:Publish` | `arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:*:task-assignments` | EC2 publishes task-assignment events to the SNS topic when a task is assigned to a user. Scoped to the single `task-assignments` topic only. |
| `cloudwatch:PutMetricData` | `*` | Next.js Server Actions publish custom metrics (`TaskCreated`, `TaskClosed`, `TimeToClose`) to the `JiraClone/Tasks` CloudWatch namespace. |
| `ssm:GetParameter`, `GetParameters` | `arn:aws:ssm:us-east-1:*:parameter/jiraclone/*` | EC2 fetches application secrets (DB config, API keys) from SSM Parameter Store at startup. Scoped to `/jiraclone/*` path only — cannot read other parameters. |

---

### JiraClone-Lambda-ImageResizer-Role

**Used by:** `image-resizer` Lambda function
**Purpose:** Triggered by S3 upload events. Reads the original image, creates a thumbnail, and updates the task record with the thumbnail URL.

**Attached Managed Policies**

| Policy | Justification |
|---|---|
| `AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole` | Required for all Lambda functions. Grants permission to write execution logs to CloudWatch Logs. |

**Inline Policy: `ImageResizerPolicy`**

| Permission | Resource | Justification |
|---|---|---|
| `s3:GetObject` | `arn:aws:s3:::jiraclone-uploads-*/*` | Reads the original uploaded image to perform resizing. Read-only on the uploads bucket — cannot write or delete. |
| `s3:PutObject` | `arn:aws:s3:::jiraclone-thumbnails-*/*` | Writes the generated thumbnail to the thumbnails bucket. Write-only on thumbnails — cannot read or delete. |
| `dynamodb:UpdateItem` | `arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/JiraClone-Tasks` | Updates the task record with the S3 URL of the generated thumbnail. Scoped to the Tasks table only — single write operation. |

**Least-privilege note:** This role has no SNS, SQS, Cognito, or SSM access. It only touches the two S3 buckets and one DynamoDB table it directly needs.

---

### JiraClone-Lambda-Notifier-Role

**Used by:** `assignment-notifier` Lambda function
**Purpose:** Triggered by SNS task-assignment events. Looks up the assignee's email in DynamoDB and sends them an email notification via SES.

**Attached Managed Policies**

| Policy | Justification |
|---|---|
| `AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole` | Required for all Lambda functions. Grants permission to write execution logs to CloudWatch Logs. |

**Inline Policy: `NotifierPolicy`**

| Permission | Resource | Justification |
|---|---|---|
| `ses:SendEmail` | `*` | Sends email notifications to task assignees. SES does not support resource-level restrictions on `SendEmail` — `*` is the AWS-required scope for this action. |
| `dynamodb:GetItem` | `arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/JiraClone-Users` | Retrieves the assignee's email address from the Users table. Read-only, single-item lookup, scoped to Users table only. |

**Least-privilege note:** This role has no S3, SNS publish, SQS, or CloudWatch metrics access. It only reads one DynamoDB table and sends email.

---

### JiraClone-Lambda-Logger-Role

**Used by:** `activity-logger` Lambda function
**Purpose:** Consumes audit events from the SQS queue and writes them to the AuditLogs DynamoDB table. Also publishes CloudWatch metrics for monitoring.

**Attached Managed Policies**

| Policy | Justification |
|---|---|
| `AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole` | Required for all Lambda functions. Grants permission to write execution logs to CloudWatch Logs. |

**Inline Policy: `LoggerPolicy`**

| Permission | Resource | Justification |
|---|---|---|
| `sqs:ReceiveMessage`, `DeleteMessage`, `GetQueueAttributes` | `arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:*:activity-log-queue` | Polls the SQS queue for audit events, processes them, and deletes them after processing. Scoped to the single `activity-log-queue` — cannot access other queues. |
| `dynamodb:PutItem` | `arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/JiraClone-AuditLogs` | Writes processed audit log entries to the AuditLogs table. Write-only, single table — cannot read, update, or delete records. |
| `cloudwatch:PutMetricData` | `*` | Publishes activity metrics to CloudWatch for dashboard monitoring. |

**Least-privilege note:** This role has no S3, SNS, Cognito, or SSM access. It only consumes from one SQS queue and writes to one DynamoDB table.

---

### JiraClone-Lambda-Digest-Role

**Used by:** `daily-digest` Lambda function
**Purpose:** Triggered daily by EventBridge. Scans for overdue tasks and publishes a digest summary to the SNS daily-digest topic, which emails all subscribers.

**Attached Managed Policies**

| Policy | Justification |
|---|---|
| `AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole` | Required for all Lambda functions. Grants permission to write execution logs to CloudWatch Logs. |

**Inline Policy: `DigestPolicy`**

| Permission | Resource | Justification |
|---|---|---|
| `dynamodb:Scan` | `arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/JiraClone-Tasks` | Scans the Tasks table to find tasks with past due dates that are not yet completed. Read-only scan, scoped to Tasks table only. |
| `sns:Publish` | `arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:*:daily-digest-topic` | Publishes the daily digest summary to the SNS topic, which triggers email delivery to all subscribers. Scoped to the single `daily-digest-topic` only. |

**Least-privilege note:** This role has no S3, SQS, Cognito, SSM, or CloudWatch metrics access. It only reads tasks and publishes to one SNS topic.

---

### Audit Conclusions

**Least-Privilege Compliance**

All roles are scoped to the minimum permissions required:

- **No role has `*` resource access** except where AWS requires it (`ses:SendEmail`, `cloudwatch:PutMetricData`) — these actions do not support resource-level restrictions.
- **All DynamoDB access is table-specific** — no role can access tables outside the `JiraClone-*` namespace.
- **All S3 access is bucket-specific** — scoped to `jiraclone-uploads-*` and `jiraclone-thumbnails-*` only.
- **All SNS access is topic-specific** — each role can only publish to its designated topic.
- **SSM access is path-scoped** — EC2 can only read parameters under `/jiraclone/*`.

**No Privilege Escalation Risk**

No role has `iam:*`, `sts:AssumeRole` (beyond trust policy), or `*:*` permissions. No role can create, modify, or delete other IAM roles or policies.

**No Cross-Service Contamination**

Each Lambda role is isolated to its specific function:

- ImageResizer cannot publish SNS or read SQS
- Notifier cannot write to S3 or read SQS
- Logger cannot publish SNS or access S3
- Digest cannot write DynamoDB or access SQS
